steps.name: 1. existing home renders; A, B, C log in in separate browser contexts
2. A and B create posts in the existing form (시·구·동 + private place) and see each other
3. detail shows 시·구·동 only; B and anon never receive the exact place
4. B sees A as masked real name + full age; anon is asked to log in
5. B requests A post once through the existing request modal; repeat is blocked
6. A and B exchange messages in the existing chat room without reloading
7. A accepts B in the chat room → server final match (post closed)
8. only B newly sees the exact place; C still cannot
9. completion before the end time is refused by the server
10. after the end time A confirms completion and immediately submits a review
